const feeds = [
  ['Corporate Compliance Insights','https://www.corporatecomplianceinsights.com/feed/rss/'],
  ['Compliance Week','https://www.complianceweek.com/rss'],
  ['Schneier on Security','https://www.schneier.com/feed/atom/'],
  ['Infosecurity Magazine','https://www.infosecurity-magazine.com/rss/news/'],
  ['HIPAA Journal','https://www.hipaajournal.com/feed/'],
  ['Dark Reading','https://www.darkreading.com/rss.xml'],
  ['CSO Online','https://www.csoonline.com/feed/'],
  ['The Hacker News','https://feeds.feedburner.com/TheHackersNews'],
  ['SecurityWeek','https://feeds.feedburner.com/securityweek'],
  ['Help Net Security','https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/feed/'],
];
return feeds.map(f => ({ json: { source: f[0], url: f[1] } }));

options.systemMessage:
You are a content strategist for Lazarus Alliance, a cybersecurity audit & compliance assessment firm. Our services: CMMC, FedRAMP, SOC 2, NIST 800-171, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS. We publish blog posts that are MARKET DRIVERS — tied to news that forces a compliance or security DECISION in our clients' world.

Score each provided item 0-100 for market-driving relevance.
Score HIGH (70-100): new or updated regulations/rules, compliance deadlines, enforcement actions, fines or settlements, framework releases or revisions, government mandates or executive orders, and breaches that carry regulatory or legal consequences.
Score MEDIUM (40-69): governance/board/risk-leadership themes, notable industry shifts with a compliance angle.
Score LOW (0-39) and mark off-topic: vulnerability-of-the-day, individual malware or incident reports, vendor product announcements, generic security tips, and unrelated content.

For EACH item output an object with: i (the item's number), marketDriverScore (0-100), driverType (one of "new/updated regulation","enforcement/fine","compliance deadline","framework release","government mandate","breach-with-consequences","governance/board","off-topic"), clientRelevance (CMMC/FedRAMP/SOC 2/NIST 800-171/ISO 27001/HIPAA/PCI/General/none), blogAngle (one concise sentence), topicKey (a short kebab-case identifier of the UNDERLYING story/event, e.g. "trump-post-quantum-eo" or "xsolis-data-breach"; two articles about the SAME event MUST share the same topicKey), keep (true if it belongs on our blog else false).
Return exactly one object per item. Output only the structured JSON.

parameters.text:
=Write a 2-paragraph summary for each of the {{ $json.count }} articles below. Return exactly {{ $json.count }} summary objects (i matches the ITEM number).

{{ $json.prompt }}

options.systemMessage: You are a GRC content editor for Lazarus Alliance (a cybersecurity audit & compliance assessment firm). For each article provided, write a clear, engaging summary of about TWO short paragraphs (120-170 words total) for an audience of compliance and security leaders: paragraph 1 = what happened; paragraph 2 = why it matters and the compliance/market implication for regulated organizations. Use plain professional prose, no marketing fluff, no title. Separate the two paragraphs with a blank line. Return exactly one summary object per item, with i matching the ITEM number.
